title: Scale attempt-010 to denser 2D sweep after review
description: After reviewing the low-resolution attempt-010 SSCS encoding heatmap, increase the Delta x / Delta Ca grid density and rerun the 2D scan if approved.
notes: Ran the widened exact contour scan at 50x50 with direct Julia binary and detached logging after clearing unhealthy launcher-state. Parameters: ΔCa in [-45,-20], Δx in [-1.5,-0.5], MAX_SEQ_LENGTH=4, tick steps 5 (ΔCa) and 0.1 (Δx), output tag wide50x50_seq4. Results: 2399/2500 successful points, 537 unique T encodings, 769 unique gamma encodings, 101 failed points. Outputs: wide50x50_seq4_contours.png, wide50x50_seq4_results.tsv, wide50x50_seq4_T_legend.tsv, wide50x50_seq4_gamma_legend.tsv, wide50x50_seq4.log. Cleaned up stale run PID files after completion.
close_reason: Completed the denser exact attempt-010/011 sweeps, added contour-prefix plotting in attempt-011, and generated/preserved the image artifacts while leaving bulky data outputs uncommitted.

comments.author: Carter Hinsley
comments.text: 20x20 exact calibration run completed successfully with JULIA_NUM_THREADS=10: 400/400 points succeeded, 148 unique encodings. Benchmark over the full 20x20 grid: serial=96.629211 s (0.241573 s/point), threaded=56.951214 s (0.142378 s/point), threaded speedup=1.6967x. Updated projections from this denser calibration: 100x100 threaded ~1423.78 s (~23.73 min), 200x200 threaded ~5695.12 s (~94.92 min). Representative per-point section timings: gamma_sd=0.000783 s, init_T0=0.186257 s, T_sscs=0.042822 s, gamma_sscs=0.099541 s.

title: Investigate anti-diagonal-invariant contour quantity for Chebyshev cubic
description: The Chebyshev cubic family is conjugate under (u,v)->(-v,-u), but contouring on raw kneading matrix equality remains only approximately symmetric because conjugate maps can induce relabeled kneading matrices. Investigate a contour quantity or comparison rule that is invariant under this conjugacy while preserving the intended contour structure.
